Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Woodley Modern Dining Room Kitchen Chairs, Set of 2, 40"H, Grey
Colors: Gray
This classic Parsons-style chair is a perfect middle ground between rustic, farmhouse charm and sleek, contemporary sophistication. The squared frame, natural wooden legs, and gray upholstery are equally at home in a minimalist modern or cozy homespun motif. Solid wood frame, fabric Versatile style is ideal for both farmhouse and modern-contemporary looks 24"D x 17.5"W x 40"H, 2PCS/CTN No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
